assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, heritage constraints, road redlines, ownership, current buildings, municipal utilities, hydrology, fire safety and engineering conditions are not supplied.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, parcel-level, demolition, height, intensity, bridge/tunnel, utility-capacity, investment or approval conclusion may be drawn; prototype geometry must be replaced or recalibrated after professional surveys and official attachments.

assumptions.statement: The site boundary and all three key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional rough geometry, not organizer-supplied official polygons.
assumptions.impact: All dependent land-use, prototype, route, open-space, phasing, area, length and ratio evidence is discussion-only and must be regenerated when official coordinate-system-qualified polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The Consent Line protocol, three civic test grounds, annual event, review panel and operating roles are proposed governance patterns; no implementing body, staff, venue, budget or approval is confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot requires a named service owner, staff and maintenance plan, legal/security/accessibility/professional review, incident procedure, expiry date and human stop authority before operation.

assumptions.statement: There is no observed baseline for accessibility, heat comfort, energy use, human takeover, complaint handling, service demand, talent attraction or innovation performance.
assumptions.impact: The package records formulas and pre-trial measurement gates but makes no numeric performance claim or benefit forecast; thresholds must be co-defined before trials and published with denominators and review periods.

assumptions.statement: Open-source review, interviews, workshops and scenario co-tests proposed by this submission are design-research participation, not the statutory public-consultation procedure of a planning authority.
assumptions.impact: Participation records may inform design iteration but cannot be represented as official consultation, public consent, approval or a substitute for legally required procedures.

assumptions.statement: Step-free routes, tactile/visual/audio information, quiet interfaces and staffed fallback are design requirements, not verified conditions; Article 39 human-service duties are referenced only for the specific listed public-service venue contexts.
assumptions.impact: Venue-specific law and standards review plus co-testing with disabled and older users are required; the proposal does not infer universal legal duties or existing compliance.

assumptions.statement: Shade, heat refuge, rainfall observation, drainage and outage modes are conceptual because hydrology, canopy, material, energy and seasonal microclimate data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No flood, thermal-comfort, carbon, drainage-capacity or energy-performance result is claimed; professional modelling, field observation and emergency review are prerequisites.

assumptions.statement: Seven external cases are primary official or institutional sources used only to compare governance, ecosystem, living-lab and district-connection methods.
assumptions.impact: Their outcomes, scale, organizations, policy settings and spatial solutions do not demonstrate Jingzhang feasibility and are not copied as local controls, forecasts or implementation commitments.
